result.summary: Found 2 layout/content issues: a truncated restaurant name in the Fastest near you carousel and an incomplete rating label on the popular ramen card.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off on the third card in Fastest near you (likely full name 'Trattoria Piccola' or similar).
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure card width and text truncation (ellipsis) handle longer names without hard clipping mid-word.

issues.description: Rating text shows '4.8 (500+)' which looks incomplete or oddly formatted compared to typical '4.8 (500+ ratings)' style labels.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearer full label such as '4.8 (500+)' with an aria/accessibility label, or '4.8 · 500+ ratings' for consistency.
